name: Tsubame (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tsubame city emblem in green, blue and orange: a green and blue stylised swallow with an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Tsubame, a city in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 March 2006.

features.role: Tsubame city emblem — a green and blue stylised swallow with an orange disc
